title: Heading
summary: A section title within a page.

requirements.text: A heading block has a level from 1 to `heading.levels`.

A page's title is the largest text on it. Headings are smaller than the title and get smaller with their level (`heading.size-1` to `heading.size-3`, against the text), the smallest still larger than the text.

values.description: A level-1 heading's size, against the text's.
A level-2 heading's size, against the text's.
A level-3 heading's size, against the text's.
